_note: C4a reverses W-093a Q2a: DEEMED_DIVIDEND is the s.2(40)(f) / 2(22)(f) kind (Gazette 265620 p.10). Drafted by Claude, adopted by the owner's ruling C4a (W-323, D-662).
label: Dividend income u/s 2(22)(e)

source.guidance: A dividend u/s 2(22)(e), a loan or advance to a shareholder, is not a kind the computation holds; enter it from your records
